### You Cannot Lose in the End
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/you-cannot-lose-in-the-end
Passage: Matthew 27:65
Points:
- Religious and civil authorities did everything possible to secure Jesus' tomb, but their efforts were completely futile.
- Christ could easily break out of death because nobody forced Him into the grave against His will.
- Jesus laid down His life entirely of His own accord and had full authority to take it up again.
- While the world thought Jesus was finished, God was silently working life out of death in the darkness.
- Because the risen Christ possesses an indestructible life, those who follow and trust Him cannot lose.

### Christ's Tomb is Sealed
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/christs-tomb-sealed
Passage: Matthew 27:62-66
Points:
- The governor granting Jesus' body for burial confirms Pilate never believed Christ was guilty of treason against Rome.
- The massive rolled stone, imperial wax seal, and armed soldiers made the tomb impossible for intruders to breach.
- The paranoid precautions of the religious leaders refute theories that Jesus merely swooned or that fearful disciples stole His body.
- The extraordinary security measures unintentionally provide powerful historical evidence for the reality of Christ's resurrection.
- Christians can stand on solid apologetic ground knowing Jesus truly died and physically conquered the grave.
